ModMetadata.Name: KTrapIC - Kotlin to IC10 Compiler
ModMetadata.Author: Christian Jackson-Gruber
ModMetadata.Description:
Program IC10 chips in Kotlin. KTrapIC adds a "Kotlin" language to the IC10 Editor mod: write a program against typed devices, batches and slots, see the IC10 it compiles to as you type, and export it to the chip as IC10. The Kotlin source is kept with the chip, so it opens as Kotlin again.
- Save-compatible: chips run plain IC10, so removing the mod leaves them working - Highlighting, a live IC10 preview with compile errors, and size and register counts - The IC10 lines of the line you're on are highlighted in the preview - A program that starts with @file:Compact compiles with labels resolved to line numbers, to save lines
On first use the mod downloads the compiler and a Java runtime for it (about 110 MB) from the project's GitHub release.
[b]Installation[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad plugin mod and needs the IC10 Editor mod. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
[b]Credits[/b] KTrapIC is modelled on aproposmath's PyTrapIC, which does the same for Python, and is built on aproposmath's IC10 Editor mod. Thank you to aproposmath for both. PyTrapIC: https://github.com/aproposmath/stationeers-pytrapic IC10 Editor: https://github.com/aproposmath/StationeersIC10Editor
Source code and language guide: https://github.com/subitan/stationeers-ktrapic
